name: Next.js
prompt:
In this folder, set up a small Next.js app using the App Router (JavaScript or TypeScript, your choice) with the standard `dev`, `build` and `start` npm scripts. It needs:

1. `/` renders a page that contains the text `FirstShot home`.
2. `/posts/<slug>` renders a page whose `<h1>` is `Post: <slug>`, for example `/posts/hello-world` shows `Post: hello-world`.
3. `GET /api/health` returns JSON `{ "status": "ok" }`.
4. `GET /api/users/<id>` returns JSON `{ "id": "<id>" }`.
5. Any request to a path under `/old/` is redirected to the same path under `/new/`, keeping the query string, so `/old/docs/intro?x=1` goes to `/new/docs/intro?x=1`. Do this in code that intercepts requests before they are routed, not with `redirects` in the Next.js config.

Do not use external fonts or anything that needs network access at build time. Make sure `npm run build` succeeds, and do not leave a server running when you are done.

Install the dependencies with npm.
